newsitem.title: USA: Century Inds sees Q2 gains similar to Q1.
newsitem.headline: Century Inds sees Q2 gains similar to Q1.

text.p: Century Industries Inc said Monday it expects a profitable second quarter, with revenues and earnings maintaining the year-over-year percentage gains seen in the first quarter.
It said first half consolidated revenues are estimated to be more than $7 million, with projected operating income at over $700,000.
For the full year, it projects minimum earnings of $1.4 million.

It said that during the third quarter it plans to exchange preferred stock held by its subsidiaries for common shares. If the exchange occurs, Century's 1997 earnings are projected to be $0.23 a share.
It said the swap will premit it to apply its consolidated earnings solely to its common shares, of which about six million are outstanding.
Century is the holding company for Century Steel Products Inc and U.S. Insurance Brokers Inc.
